summary: No operator page could be found. Newaygo County Parks' site now lists only Sandy Beach, Ed Henning, Diamond Lake and White Cloud county parks (online booking on FireFly for those four), the Hardy Dam marina and the Sports Park; Pettibone Lake appears nowhere, though search snippets of an older county FAQ named 'Pettibone Lake County Park'. Google Maps at the entry's pin shows 'Pettibone Lake Park', 490 Pettibone Dr, 3.8 stars from 30 reviews, website lilleytownship.com and phone (231) 345-6381 (Lilley Township's office); reviews describe a day-use park with a covered picnic area, swing set and permit boat launch and 'no bathrooms', and one 8-year-old review mentions 'a camp ground across the street'. Lilley Township's site and 2023 master plan say nothing about a park or campground. Cleared the derived site count, 40-ft maximum, vault toilets and season (all from the RV Life listing). RV Life $ tier left in rating. Note left as is.
flags: Possible closure / operator unknown: Newaygo County Parks no longer lists Pettibone Lake on any page (its campgrounds, reservations and rates pages cover Sandy Beach, Ed Henning, Diamond Lake and White Cloud only), and the Google listing at this pin is a day-use park linked to Lilley Township (reviews: picnic shelter, swing set, boat launch, 'no bathrooms'). No official source shows camping here now. A call to Newaygo County Parks (231-689-7340, the entry's phone) or Lilley Township (231-345-6381) is needed before keeping it.
Aggregator link in website: the entry links only an RV Life listing (campgrounds.rvlife.com); no county or township page for a campground exists to replace it.
No posted rate, booking method or season from any operator.
